name: Woodland Christmas Wreath
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
summary: An evergreen door wreath with a crimson velvet bow, shingled pinecones and a woven willow back.
description: Fir sprays and willow stems encircle a crimson bow, three pine cones and holly berries. A bound brass loop hangs the wreath from the back.
license: Project original; no public redistribution license specified.
creation_method: Seeded editable Blender meshes, hand-composed branches and ribbon surfaces, vertex-painted needle pigments, source-owned PBR materials and a Blender Cycles studio.
rights: Original owner-project asset. Public redistribution terms are unspecified.

attribution.credit: Original willow, sprigs, holly, pinecones, bow, hardware, materials and studio images created for Blender-3D-Gallery. No third-party meshes, image textures, logos or lettering.

placement.origin: Centre of the woven ring projected onto its nominal rear wall plane.

accuracy_notes: Decorative evergreen wreath. The twig arrangement, holly, three pine cones and brass hanging loop are modeled in metres.
